defectsRegister.issue: Missing customized 404 Not Found page for invalid destination slugs or mistyped URLs, causing Next.js default fallback without Pune theme branding.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Absence of Next.js App Router root not-found.tsx handler.
defectsRegister.fix: Created app/not-found.tsx with Marathi & English bilingual recovery options, quick links to Home, Destinations, Planner, and My Journey.
defectsRegister.verification: Passed app/not-found.tsx verification and test suite tests/qaAuditMaster.test.ts

defectsRegister.issue: Missing client-side root error boundary, risking white-screen crash if an unhandled React rendering exception occurs during canvas/video synthesis.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Lack of App Router error boundary 'use client' file.
defectsRegister.fix: Implemented app/error.tsx with error stack logging, safe state recovery reset() button, and emergency return navigation.
defectsRegister.verification: Verified error component renders properly and passes build checks without warnings

defectsRegister.issue: Journey Dashboard and Reel Studio workspaces caused horizontal overflow on viewports <= 860px due to fixed two-column grid (260px 1fr).
defectsRegister.rootCause: Hardcoded multi-column template without mobile media queries in early prototype CSS.
defectsRegister.fix: Added comprehensive responsive CSS in app/globals.css collapsing .journey-grid-layout to 1fr, transforming .journey-sidebar into a smooth horizontal touch-scroll pill strip, and stacking .reel-studio-workspace vertically.
defectsRegister.verification: Verified 7 viewport breakpoints in tests/qaAuditMaster.test.ts with zero horizontal overflow

defectsRegister.issue: Missing target CSS hooks on sidebar and studio editor workspace containers.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Omitted explicit className hooks matching the responsive stylesheet rules.
defectsRegister.fix: Assigned className='journey-sidebar' and className='reel-studio-workspace' with ARIA landmarks.
defectsRegister.verification: Validated class assignment and CSS media query binding
